manualSmokeScenarios.name: catalog-from-yudao
manualSmokeScenarios.expected: Product list loads from Yudao when backend has enabled products; otherwise demo products remain visible.

manualSmokeScenarios.name: product-detail-from-yudao
manualSmokeScenarios.expected: Product detail shows Yudao name, cover, price, market price, stock, and add-to-cart action.

manualSmokeScenarios.name: remote-cart
manualSmokeScenarios.expected: Adding a Yudao product calls remote cart add and cart drawer shows remote cart items.

manualSmokeScenarios.name: checkout-token-required
manualSmokeScenarios.expected: Checkout page explains that a Yudao App token is needed for remote order creation.

manualSmokeScenarios.name: checkout-create-order
manualSmokeScenarios.expected: Remote cart items settle and create a Yudao order using deliveryType 1.

manualSmokeScenarios.name: orders-list-and-detail
manualSmokeScenarios.expected: Order list loads and an order detail can be opened with /orders?id=<orderId>.
